title: Soviet DShK 12.7×108mm Ammunition Transport Box

sources.scale_model_kit: TA072 (Tank Model) — Soviet Ammo Box 12.7 DShK & NSVT MG — Scalemates
sources.firearm_reference: How the DShK 12.7mm Machine Gun Functions — The Firearm Blog
sources.soviet_standard: Degtyarev-Shpagin DSHK and DSHKM heavy machine gun — gunrf.ru (Russian Federation gun reference)
sources.ammo_spec: 12.7 × 108 mm — Wikipedia article on Soviet heavy machine gun ammunition
sources.markings: Decoding Soviet Military Surplus Ammunition Labels — DCAF Conflict Armament Research
sources.military_encyclopedia: Военная энциклопедия (Soviet Military Encyclopedia) — ordnance container standards

capacity.src: TA072 scale model kit specifications; firearm_reference confirms standard DShK box capacity
capacity.note: Transport box; feed system on gun holds 50-round belts in rotary magazine

ammo_dimensions.note: Used to calculate box internal volume and proportions

box_dimensions_estimated.src: TA072 scale model kit (proportions); actual GOST dimensions unknown — needs museum/catalog verification
box_dimensions_estimated.derivation: 85 rounds in alternating rows (head-to-tail, tail-to-head) with paper separators; 130mm × 85 ≈ 280mm length; ~3 rows across 140mm width; height accommodates ±65mm row stack

weight_total_kg.src: Soviet ordnance field manuals (approximate, not sourced to specific ГОСТ)
weight_total_kg.note: Informational; not used in voxel model

construction.primary_paint: Olive drab (Советский защитный цвет) — darker/warmer than US olive, yellow-brown cast
construction.hardware: Brass or bronze latches, hinges, and fasteners
construction.closure: Lever-operated lock with rubber gasket seal (hermetic when closed)
construction.straps: Canvas-backed leather webbing for carrying/lashing (two longitudinal straps)
construction.handle: Flat-folding steel handle, stowed on top when not in use
construction.src: TA072 scale model kit; firearm_reference; soviet_standard (Шпагин design documentation)

markings.content: Factory identification (Ф or Завод № XX), production year (two-digit YY), lot/batch number (ЛОТ №), cartridge type stencil (7.62×54Р, 12.7×108 ПЗБ-М, etc.), unit acceptance marks (УОП)
markings.insignia: Red star (Пятиконечная звезда) center front; Soviet state emblem
markings.src: Decoding Soviet Military Surplus Ammunition Labels (DCAF CAR); military_encyclopedia

hardware_derived.strap_positions_mm: ±95 from centre (outboard of the rear hinges at ±70)
hardware_derived.src: geometric derivation from box_dimensions_estimated + construction (TA072 kit proportions; lid ≈ 0.2 × height, handle ≈ 0.54 × length)
hardware_derived.derivation: DERIVED, not independently sourced (raw GOST figures remain in needs[]): lid 0.2×140 ≈ 28; handle spans ~half the lid length; straps clear the hinge knuckles; latch plates / star / stencils scaled from kit box-art proportions

feed_system_context.rotary_magazine: Шпагин feed sprocket system (revolver-style rotating magazine with 6 chambers, holds 50-round disintegrating-link belt)
feed_system_context.box_usage: Transport/storage container; weapons-mounted magazine is separate

game_model_purpose: Loot prop — standalone ammo-box item that players can pick up in the world to resupply DShK ammunition (analogous to M2A1 .50-cal ammo can already in game)
needs: Exact dimensions (mm) from a Soviet ГОСТ ammunition box standard or museum catalog
